info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Account Details API
info.description: The Customer Account Details API provides access to specific account information for a given customer. With this endpoint, developers can retrieve detailed data about a customer's account using their unique identifiers. It is particularly useful for applications that require individualized account summaries or insights for customer engagement. Typical consumers include financial services applications, customer support platforms, and user account management systems.

get.summary: Retrieve account details for a specific customer.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the account information associated with the customer identified by CUST-100045. It returns comprehensive details about the specified account, including account balances and transaction history.
